title: CHERNOBYL 1986
en: One button was pressed. And an entire city was emptied forever.
Chernobyl's reactor number four exploded during a test.
Firefighters went to fight the fire with no protection. Many died within weeks.
The nearby city of Pripyat knew nothing for 36 hours.
Then came the announcement. 50,000 people were moved out of the city in three and a half hours.
They were told it was only for three days. They never came back.
On the reactor roof, each man had just 90 seconds.
Even today, melted fuel lies beneath the reactor. The Elephant's Foot.
And this land will stay radioactive for thousands of years.
Watch the full story on the channel.
